metadata.name: Core Builds
metadata.description: One Core Builds setup for any device and service. Answer a few questions (device, picture, what matters most, language) and pick your service; you get the same config the Core Builds configurator would build.
metadata.author: Brevity

inputs.name: What do you watch on?
inputs.description: Sets the video and audio formats Core Builds prefers or avoids, such as Dolby Vision, AV1 and lossless audio.

inputs.name: Picture
inputs.description: 4K shows 2160p first with 1080p behind it. 1080p leaves 4K out. Mixed has no hard limit.

inputs.name: What matters most
inputs.description: Fast keeps files small, Balanced suits most people, Maximum searches widest with no size limit.

inputs.name: Only streams that play straight away
inputs.description: Hides anything your service would still have to download first.

inputs.name: Language you watch in
inputs.description: Releases in this language come first when everything else is equal. English and original-audio releases still show.

inputs.name: Mostly anime
inputs.description: Adds anime sources such as Anime Tosho.
